name: Natural language contact intelligence layer (LLM Solutions)

mentions.name: Natural language contact intelligence layer (LLM Solutions)
mentions.description: A natural language intelligence layer for contacts that answers queries like "Pull everyone I know who works at a Series A healthtech in the Bay Area who also went to Stanford for ungrad" with either structured or unstructured results. It supports large-scale data, automatically enriches contacts with up-to-date data, and delivers fast, accurate results, integrating natively with Gmail and Google Calendar. Currently seeking free pilots with early-stage startups.
mentions.audience: Small qualified teams, specifically early-stage startups with a real/immediate need (targeting free pilots)
